    SELECT 0 AS sort_order, '— All sites —' AS __text, '' AS __value

    SELECT 1, site_name, site_id::text

    WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
) ranked

panels.title: Analytics Explorer (max 5 assets X 5 metrics)
panels.description: Routed through analytics.get_grafana_explorer_intervals: native samples for <=24h ranges, 15-minute rollups for <=14d, hourly rollups beyond that. Hard-capped at 5 assets and 5 metrics -- the Asset/Metric arrays are CASE-guarded below so a >5 selection returns zero rows instead of reaching the database's own hard exception. There is no separate status banner: exceeding the limit currently renders as a silently empty chart with no on-screen explanation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selection AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN array_length(NULLIF(ARRAY[${Asset:singlequote}]::uuid[], ARRAY[NULL::uuid]), 1) <= 5
            THEN ARRAY[${Asset:singlequote}]::uuid[]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::uuid[]
        END AS asset_ids,
        CASE
            WHEN array_length(NULLIF(ARRAY[${Metric:singlequote}]::text[], ARRAY[NULL::text]), 1) <= 5
            THEN ARRAY[${Metric:singlequote}]::text[]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END AS logical_points
),

raw_data AS (
    SELECT
        x.interval_start,
        COALESCE(sel_a.asset_name, x.asset_id::text) AS asset_name,
        COALESCE(sel_p.logical_point, x.logical_point_id::text) AS logical_point_name,
        x.avg_value,
        x.max_value

    FROM selection

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL analytics.get_grafana_explorer_intervals(
        ${__org.id}::bigint,
        selection.asset_ids,
        selection.logical_points,
        $__timeFrom()::timestamptz,
        $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    ) AS x

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT asset_name
        FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_selector
        WHERE asset_id = x.asset_id
          AND grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS sel_a ON TRUE

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT logical_point
        FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_point_selector
        WHERE logical_point_id = x.logical_point_id
          AND grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS sel_p ON TRUE
)

SELECT
    interval_start AS time,

    CASE
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%ENERGY%' THEN
            GREATEST(
                0,
                max_value - LAG(max_value) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY asset_name, logical_point_name
                    ORDER BY interval_start
                )
            )
        ELSE avg_value
    END AS value,

    asset_name || ' - ' || logical_point_name AS metric

FROM raw_data

ORDER BY
    interval_start,
    CASE
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%ENERGY%' THEN 0
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%POWER_FACTOR%' THEN 5
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%THD%' THEN 9
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%POWER%' THEN 1
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%VOLTAGE%' THEN 2
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%CURRENT%' THEN 3
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%FREQUENCY%' THEN 4
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%TEMPERATURE%' THEN 6
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%HUMIDITY%' THEN 7
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%ILLUMINANCE%' THEN 8
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%PHASE_ANGLE%' THEN 10
        ELSE 11
    END,
    logical_point_name,
    asset_name

panels.title: Summary (per metric, aggregated across selected assets)
panels.description: Metric-level rollup of the same analytics.get_grafana_explorer_intervals data feeding the chart above, for the currently selected dashboard time range. Energy aggregates additively (Total = sum of per-asset consumption, Average = sum of per-asset mean interval consumption); Power/Current/Voltage/Power Factor aggregate as the mean of the per-asset averages, with Max/Min taken as the true extremes across assets. Total is blank where it is not a meaningful quantity. Blank = not applicable / no data; a genuine measured zero renders as 0.00.

targets.rawSql: WITH selection AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN array_length(NULLIF(ARRAY[${Asset:singlequote}]::uuid[], ARRAY[NULL::uuid]), 1) <= 5 THEN ARRAY[${Asset:singlequote}]::uuid[] ELSE ARRAY[]::uuid[] END AS asset_ids, CASE WHEN array_length(NULLIF(ARRAY[${Metric:singlequote}]::text[], ARRAY[NULL::text]), 1) <= 5 THEN ARRAY[${Metric:singlequote}]::text[] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END AS logical_points ), raw_data AS ( SELECT x.interval_start, COALESCE(sel_a.asset_name, x.asset_id::text) AS asset_name, COALESCE(sel_p.logical_point, x.logical_point_id::text) AS logical_point_name, x.avg_value, x.min_value, x.max_value FROM selection CROSS JOIN LATERAL analytics.get_grafana_explorer_intervals( ${__org.id}::bigint, selection.asset_ids, selection.logical_points, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz ) AS x LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT asset_name FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_selector WHERE asset_id = x.asset_id AND grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} LIMIT 1 ) AS sel_a ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT logical_point FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_point_selector WHERE logical_point_id = x.logical_point_id AND grafana_org_id = ${__org.id} LIMIT 1 ) AS sel_p ON TRUE ), delta_data AS ( SELECT asset_name, logical_point_name, (logical_point_name ILIKE '%ENERGY%') AS is_energy, CASE WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%ENERGY%' THEN GREATEST(0, max_value - LAG(max_value) OVER (PARTITION BY asset_name, logical_point_name ORDER BY interval_start)) ELSE avg_value END AS series_value, min_value, max_value FROM raw_data ), per_series AS ( SELECT asset_name, logical_point_name, CASE WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%ENERGY%' THEN 'energy' WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%POWER_FACTOR%' THEN 'pf' WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%THD%' THEN 'thd' WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%POWER%' THEN 'power' WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%VOLTAGE%' THEN 'voltage' WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%CURRENT%' THEN 'current' WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%FREQUENCY%' THEN 'frequency' WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%TEMPERATURE%' THEN 'temperature' WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%HUMIDITY%' THEN 'humidity' WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%ILLUMINANCE%' THEN 'illuminance' WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%PHASE_ANGLE%' THEN 'phase_angle' ELSE 'other' END AS family, CASE WHEN bool_or(is_energy) THEN SUM(series_value) ELSE NULL END AS total_v, AVG(series_value) AS avg_v, CASE WHEN bool_or(is_energy) THEN MAX(series_value) ELSE MAX(max_value) END AS max_v, CASE WHEN bool_or(is_energy) THEN MIN(series_value) ELSE MIN(min_value) END AS min_v FROM delta_data GROUP BY asset_name, logical_point_name ), per_metric AS ( SELECT logical_point_name, family, CASE WHEN family = 'energy' THEN SUM(total_v) ELSE NULL END AS total_v, CASE WHEN family = 'energy' THEN SUM(avg_v) ELSE AVG(avg_v) END AS avg_v, MAX(max_v) AS max_v, MIN(min_v) AS min_v FROM per_series GROUP BY logical_point_name, family ) SELECT logical_point_name AS "Meter", CASE WHEN family = 'energy' THEN to_char(total_v / 1000.0, 'FM999999990.00') || ' kWh' WHEN family = 'power' THEN CASE WHEN abs(total_v) >= 1000 THEN to_char(total_v / 1000.0, 'FM999999990.00') || ' kW' ELSE to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' W' END WHEN family = 'current' THEN to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' A' WHEN family = 'voltage' THEN to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' V' WHEN family = 'pf' THEN to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') WHEN family = 'thd' THEN to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' %' WHEN family = 'frequency' THEN to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' Hz' WHEN family = 'temperature' THEN to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' °C' WHEN family = 'humidity' THEN to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' %' WHEN family = 'illuminance' THEN to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' %' WHEN family = 'phase_angle' THEN to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' °' ELSE to_char(total_v, 'FM999999990.00') END AS "Total", CASE WHEN family = 'energy' THEN to_char(avg_v / 1000.0, 'FM999999990.00') || ' kWh' WHEN family = 'power' THEN CASE WHEN abs(avg_v) >= 1000 THEN to_char(avg_v / 1000.0, 'FM999999990.00') || ' kW' ELSE to_char(avg_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' W' END WHEN family = 'current' THEN to_char(avg_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' A' WHEN family = 'voltage' THEN to_char(avg_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' V' WHEN family = 'pf' THEN to_char(avg_v, 'FM999999990.00') WHEN family = 'thd' THEN to_char(avg_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' %' WHEN family = 'frequency' THEN to_char(avg_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' Hz' WHEN family = 'temperature' THEN to_char(avg_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' °C' WHEN family = 'humidity' THEN to_char(avg_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' %' WHEN family = 'illuminance' THEN to_char(avg_v, 'FM999999990.00') || ' %' WHEN || ' °' ELSE to_char(max_v, 'FM999999990.00') END AS "Max", CASE WHEN family = 'energy' THEN to_char(min_v / 1000.0, 'FM999999990.00') || ' kWh' WHEN family = 'power' THEN CASE WHEN abs(min_v) >= 1000 per_metric ORDER BY CASE family WHEN 'energy' THEN 0 WHEN 'power' THEN 1 WHEN 'voltage' THEN 2 WHEN 'current' THEN 3 WHEN 'frequency' THEN 4 WHEN 'pf' THEN 5 WHEN 'temperature' THEN 6 WHEN 'humidity' panels.title: Individual (per asset and metric)
panels.description: Per (asset, metric) breakdown of the same analytics.get_grafana_explorer_intervals data feeding the chart above, for the currently selected dashboard time range.
